label: disputed
text: Prime Minister Edi Rama and Mayor Erion Veliaj publicly clashed over the mayor’s prison transfer and alleged involvement in student protests. Veliaj accused Rama of ordering his move to Fier prison and threatening his municipal mandate, while Justice Minister Toni Gogu denied any political interference, calling the claims fabricated.

sources.title: Rama-Veliaj Rift Erupts Into Open Political Confrontation - Tirana Times
sources.articleText:
TIRANA, Albania – An unprecedented confrontation has erupted between Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama and Tirana Mayor Erion Veliaj, turning a dispute over the mayor’s prison transfer into an open political conflict within the ruling Socialist Party and raising serious questions about the alleged use of state institutions to settle political differences.
The confrontation escalated Monday after Veliaj accused Rama of orchestrating his transfer to Fier prison, pressuring him to relinquish control of Tirana Municipality and threatening additional criminal proceedings if he refused. The allegations, which have not been independently verified, represent an extraordinary challenge to Rama by a politician who was once among his closest allies and one of the Socialist Party’s most prominent figures.
